options.label: Post as text
options.description:
Moved too fast, broke the front door.

Checked our analytics and realized the Oopuo contact form hasn't been sending data for a week. A placeholder ID in the code was sitting there while we were busy scaling.

Most people would hide that. I'm posting it because that's the cost of speed.

Form is fixed. Now we're heads down on the 'Whale Strategy' for IAM. We identified 5 targets that control over 2,000 locations. 

Focus > Everything.

options.label: Record video
options.description: Record a 30s selfie video. Script: 'Yo, quick update from the trenches. We just found a major bug—our lead form was dead for a week because of a stupid placeholder. It happens when you build at this speed. Fixed now. But check this: we just mapped out the 5 biggest players in the Dutch kindergarten market for IAM. 2,000 locations in just 5 meetings. That’s the power of the Oopuo engine. Build fast, fix fast, aim big.'
